faultVisualStates.meaning: No active fault for this faultId.
Fault active, annunciated at YELLOW or ORANGE.
Instrument disagreement (lane vote or shadow residual). Used by SENSOR_DRIFT only.
Instrument value removed by range / rate / service-code checks. Used by SENSOR_DRIFT and data-path handling.
Telemetry not current (DATA_STALE). A data-path state: never highlights engine hardware.

componentRenderStates.use: No fault involvement. Always the default.
Secondary/context component of an active fault. Deliberately faint so context never reads as failed hardware.
Direct component of a fault that has just cleared; fades to NORMAL.
Instrument whose channel is INVALID (range, rate or service-code failure). Data-quality state, not mechanical damage.
Instrument whose channel is SUSPECT (lane disagreement / residual). Data-quality state.
Direct component of a fault annunciated at YELLOW or ORANGE (MIL-STD-411F caution).
Direct component of a fault annunciated at RED (MIL-STD-411F warning).

componentRenderStatesNote: Highlight = original material with baseColor lerped toward the state colour by baseColorTint, plus emissive = state colour x emissiveIntensity. Emission alone washes out on coloured parts (Rotax-blue covers read white), so the tint is required.

renderModifiers.appliesTo: components not involved in the focused fault
renderModifiers.use: Optional focus aid that reveals internal components (pistons, crankshaft). Not a fault state; never used for involved components.

renderModifiers.appliesTo: involved components that enclose an involved internal component
renderModifiers.use: Keeps the state colour of a host component (cylinder, head, crankcase) while letting the internal direct component show through.

stateStacking: When several active faults address one component, render the state with the highest precedence (HIGHLIGHT_CRITICAL > HIGHLIGHT_WARNING > HIGHLIGHT_SUSPECT > HIGHLIGHT_INVALID > HIGHLIGHT_RECOVERING > HIGHLIGHT_CONTEXT > NORMAL).

animationTypes.NONE: No time-varying effect; the render state alone carries the information.
animationTypes.PULSE_STEADY: Sinusoidal emissive modulation using the render state's pulse (hz, amplitude). Event-driven: only materials currently in a pulsing state are updated per frame.
animationTypes.PULSE_INTERMITTENT: PULSE_STEADY with pseudo-random skipped beats (a beat is dropped with p=0.3). Represents intermittent firing; no geometric change, no damage effect.
animationTypes.PULSE_IRREGULAR: PULSE_STEADY with per-beat amplitude jitter (±40 % of the state amplitude). Represents unstable combustion; no geometric change.
animationTypes.MICRO_JITTER_LOCAL: Optional, off by default: a positional render offset of at most 0.3 mm applied only to the direct components (never the whole engine), amplitude scaled by vibration_rms_total. Conceptual - not a physical simulation.

faultOnset: Cox proportional hazards h(t) = h0·exp(γ·d(t)), baseline 0.004 per flight hour, 20× hazard ratio between a destroyed and an as-new pathway; sensor drift stays at a flat hazard.

faults.description: An ignition coil or spark plug fails and one cylinder stops firing. Raw fuel washes past the rings into the oil.
faults.mechanism: Expressed in engine_sim.py, not in a health factor: the affected cylinder's EGT is scaled by (1 − 0.28·m) and rpm droops 45·m with 40 % jitter. It accelerates chamber deposits ×10 and oil breakdown ×4, and is deliberately not coupled to injector fouling.
faults.signature: One cylinder cold against its three siblings, rough running, a small rpm loss at constant throttle.

rules.registerNote: The rule fires when the coldest cylinder sits more than 0.8 × the split-fault limit below the mean, above 2000 rpm.

limitations: The failing coil or plug of the selected cylinder cannot be isolated: spark plugs are one mesh per bank (2 cylinders) and the ignition coils/leads are one engine-wide mesh each.
Fuel washing into the oil is not visualised.
No mechanical damage is shown - a misfire is a signal-path fault.

nullCylinder.basis: degradation.misfire_cylinder_rates: first = f.cylinder if f.cylinder else 1

progression.rule: Above magnitude 0.5 the second cylinder of the same ignition-coil group (COIL_1_3 / COIL_2_4) also misfires.
progression.basis: degradation.py _MISFIRE_COIL_GROUP, misfire_cylinder_rates (DEV-204; IM failure matrix in configs/engines/rotax_915is.yaml)

faults.description: Deposits build on the pintle or the nozzle cokes; the per-cylinder fuel split scatters.
faults.mechanism: injector_condition ≤ 1 − 0.75·m; the injector-fouling pathway runs ×9 faster while the fault is active.
faults.signature: Cylinder-to-cylinder EGT split widening, injection-timing deviation, injector duty rising to hold fuel flow.

codeTaggedNotListed.registerNote: Tagged injector_abnormal in edge_rules.py, but the register states FUELP_LOW can never fire in simulation (fuel_pressure is constant rail pressure plus noise).

detection.registerNote: The weak F1 is inherent: a fouling fault and natural injector fouling have the same signature and differ only in rate.

limitations: Injectors are one mesh per bank; the injectors of the selected cylinder cannot be isolated from its bank partner.
Injector identification confidence in the model is 'medium'.
No fuel leak or spray is visualised (not modelled).

cylinderSemantics.note: The register classifies this mode per cylinder and InjectedFault carries the cylinder, but degradation._apply_faults does not use it: injector_condition is engine-wide and the per-cylinder EGT spread comes from injector build variation x injector wear. The 3D layer localises the DECLARED cylinder, not a physically localised simulated effect.

faults.description: Scale and fouling in the coolant jacket, or coolant-pump wear — the head-to-coolant path inside the engine.
faults.mechanism: cooling_efficiency ≤ 1 − 0.55·m; the cooling pathway runs ×7 faster. Scale deposition itself accelerates with head temperature (1 + 0.010 per °C above 105 °C).
faults.signature: CHT rises while the thermostat holds coolant steady, so the CHT-minus-coolant gap widens. Against the as-new shadow engine at the same throttle, speed, altitude and OAT the head runs 8 K hot — thermal index 0.62 — with not one certified limit exceeded.

rules.registerNote: Register: fires hundreds of hours later. Code tags it overheating_trend.

detection.registerNote: The classifier confuses it with ordinary cooling wear for the same rate-versus-state reason as the injector class.

faults.description: A developing leak, contamination, or thermal breakdown of the oil. Degraded oil then wears the bearings it is supposed to protect.
faults.mechanism: oil_quality ≤ 1 − 0.70·m, viscosity ratio ≥ 1 + 0.35·m; oil-thermal pathway ×5, bearing wear ×3. Applied after the scheduled 100 h oil change, so the fault survives a service.
faults.signature: Oil pressure low at speed and falling, oil temperature high; bearing clearance growing underneath.
limitations: The oil itself and the leak location are not modelled; the oil-system components are highlighted as its hosts.
The bearings are not separate meshes: the crankshaft and crankcase are shown as context for bearing wear.
UNKNOWN_COMPONENT_003 (07_LUBRICATION, identification confidence low) is deliberately excluded.
The oil tank sits beside the engine in the source model, not in an installed position.
No oil leak is visualised.

faults.description: Mixture and ignition quality wander — deposits, knock, lean or rich excursions. Incomplete combustion is precisely what forms chamber deposits.
faults.mechanism: combustion_efficiency ≤ 1 − 0.10·m; the deposit pathway runs ×12 faster — the largest multiplier in the table.
faults.signature: EGT high, the ECU pulling ignition timing back to hold off knock, ignition-timing deviation between cylinders, energy at the firing order in the vibration waveform.
limitations: The combustion chamber is not a separate mesh: head, barrel and piston of the cylinder are highlighted as its boundary.
The piston is internal; it is only visible with GHOSTED/XRAY or in the exploded view.
The alert rules evaluate engine-level aggregates (egt_max, ignition_timing_deviation_max); the cylinder number must come from the fault event.

cylinderSemantics.note: The register classifies this mode per cylinder and InjectedFault carries the cylinder, but combustion_efficiency is an engine-wide factor. The 3D layer localises the DECLARED cylinder.

faults.description: Heat rejection to air is lost — a blocked radiator, a duct or cowl-flap problem, lost cooling airflow. Distinct from cooling degradation, which is inside the engine.
faults.mechanism: cooling_airflow ≤ 1 − 0.75·m (a quarter of design airflow at full severity — the realistic worst case), plus a small ×1.5 on the cooling pathway.
faults.signature: The whole loop rises: CHT and coolant climb together and the difference between them barely moves.

faults.description: A rolling-element bearing spalls — outer race or inner race — and the damage propagates from first detectable to failure. Wear also raises gear-mesh amplitude.
faults.mechanism: bearing_condition ≤ 1 − 0.65·m, clearance ≥ C₀(1 + m); bearing-wear pathway ×9. The 10 kHz waveform carries 1× unbalance, 2× misalignment, gear mesh, firing frequency and — once wear passes 2 % — amplitude-modulated impulse trains at BPFO and BPFI on a 2600 Hz resonance.
faults.signature: RMS and kurtosis rise. In the order domain the defects sit at 3.589× (outer race) and 5.411× (inner race) for this 9-ball bearing.

other: EDGE order_analysis.py names the race (BPFO 3.5888×, BPFI 5.4112×)

eventFields.name: orderFinding
eventFields.note: Edge order-analysis finding (e.g. 'bearing outer race defect (BPFO …x envelope floor)'); not a bus channel.

limitations: The register's scope chip is absent for this mode; the modelled factors are engine-wide, so it is treated as engine-level.

The simulator models one generic 9-ball rolling-element bearing whose defect orders are referenced to engine speed; no bearing mesh exists, so the crankshaft is used as the direct locus (APPROXIMATE).
The gearbox has no independent wear factor (register: gear mesh scales with bearing wear) and sits beside the engine in the source model.
The accelerometer is not modelled.
The whole engine must never be shaken; MICRO_JITTER_LOCAL is optional and off by default.
